texts:
Serve or Sit for Week 7: the lineup calls you are stuck on, from Thursday night in Chicago to the coin flips.

Germie Bernard is WR24 for me, a WR2.

Lamar Jackson falls outside my top 12.

Let's get to it.
#HereWeGo #RavensFlock

Thursday night, NE at CHI, 8:15 PM ET. Chicago is a 2.5-point favorite and the total is 49.5. New England ruled out both starting guards and three cornerbacks.

Kyle Monangai is out a third straight game; pivot to D'Andre Swift.
#NEPats #DaBears

Drake Maye: 10 TD passes in his last three games, with two backup guards starting. QB2 for me tonight.

Caleb Williams: second game back from the hamstring, against a secondary missing three corners. QB5 for me tonight.
#NEPats #DaBears

D'Andre Swift: 16 carries and a TD at ATL to Roschon Johnson's 13. RB10 for me tonight.

Colston Loveland: 6 catches on 7 targets for 65 and a TD at ATL. TE9 for me tonight.
#DaBears

A.J. Brown: off the injury report, a route on 97 percent of the dropbacks and 10 targets vs NYJ, with Romeo Doubs on IR. WR26 for me tonight, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.
#NEPats

Luther Burden III: 8 catches on 8 targets in a part-time role, and New England is down three corners. WR21 for me tonight, a WR2.

Rome Odunze: 4 targets at ATL. WR40 for me tonight, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; sit him for any Tier 3 receiver.
#DaBears

Tonight's coin flip is the New England backfield.

TreVeyon Henderson lost the late carries after his fumble vs NYJ.

Rhamondre Stevenson is RB19 for me, an RB2, and the lean is to play him.
#NEPats

The week favors them, starting at quarterback.

Matthew Stafford: 25 of 33 for 222 and 2 TDs vs ARI, with Puka Nacua drawing 17 of 24 targets in Week 5. QB7 for me at LV.
#RamsHouse

Bryce Young: 11 TD passes and 1 interception through five games, a franchise record, and a full practice Wednesday. QB8 for me vs TB.

C.J. Stroud: 312 yards and 3 TDs in London. QB10 for me vs NYG.
#KeepPounding #HTownMade

Saquon Barkley: full practice Thursday from the hamstring, expected to play Monday. RB18 for me this week, an RB2.

Dameon Pierce: his 61 of 64 snaps came with Barkley out. Off my top 40; sit him and hold him as the handcuff.
#FlyEaglesFly

Woody Marks: 78 percent of the snaps at JAX, and David Montgomery missed Wednesday's practice. RB20 for me this week, an RB2.

Marvin Harrison Jr.: 26 percent of the routes, and Tank Dell is back. WR50 for me, a dart throw; sit him.
#HTownMade

Kendre Miller: 20 carries for 70 at NYG with Travis Etienne Jr. on IR. RB27 for me, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play in Paris.
#Saints

Germie Bernard: every route at TB and 21 targets over two games, with two Pittsburgh receivers on IR. WR24 for me this week, a WR2.
#HereWeGo

Keenan Allen: 9, 9 and 11 targets in Weeks 4 to 6, and Tyler Warren missed Wednesday. WR30 for me, a high-end WR3.

Josh Downs: 4 for 40 on 8 targets vs TEN. WR35 for me, a low-end WR3; sit him for Allen.
#ForTheShoe

Omar Cooper Jr.: 82 percent of the snaps and 28 of 33 routes in his first game off IR, with Miami 0-5. WR31 for me, a low-end WR3, a low-end flex play.
#JetUp #PhinsUp

Tyler Higbee: 83 percent of the snaps, and Davante Adams is out at least six weeks. TE11 for me, a borderline start this week.

Tre Tucker: 2 TDs on 7 targets. WR32 for me, a low-end WR3; sit him for any Tier 3 receiver.
#RamsHouse #RaiderNation

The week does not favor them.

Lamar Jackson: limited Wednesday with the ankle. QB21 for me, outside my top 12.

Patrick Mahomes II: both starting tackles missed Wednesday's practice. QB15 for me, outside my top 12.
#RavensFlock #ChiefsKingdom

Xavier Worthy: 7 of 7 for 73, all short, with the tackles banged up. WR34 for me; sit him for any Tier 3 receiver.

Zach Charbonnet: off PUP Thursday, first game since the ACL. RB39 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; sit him.
#ChiefsKingdom #Seahawks

Cam Skattebo: 6 snaps and 0 touches vs NO in a three-way split. RB33 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him for any Tier 3 back.

Darren Waller: 0 catches, and Tommy Tremble passed him in routes. TE20 for me; sit him.
#NYGiants #KeepPounding

Coin flips, and what flips them.

Josh Jacobs: RB17 for me, an RB2, and the lean is to play him unless Friday's report says otherwise.

Aaron Jones Sr.: RB16 for me, an RB2, until Minnesota activates Jordan Mason.
#GoPackGo #Skol

Ashton Jeanty: 14 touches to Mike Washington Jr.'s 10. RB14 for me, borderline RB1/RB2, and the lean is to play him.

Emeka Egbuka: no practice Wednesday with a concussion. WR27 only if he clears; the lean is sit.
#RaiderNation #GoBucs

Harold Fannin Jr.: 2 catches over the last two games. TE12 for me, a borderline start this week, and the lean is to play Tyler Higbee over him unless a Cleveland receiver is ruled out Friday.
#DawgPound #RamsHouse

Every call with its numbers and what flips it is on the site, and Prep Notes updates the ranks Friday after the final injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for every lineup call this week, and repost this for your league chat.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/line.html?week=7
